استنهضن (form X)
# اِسْتَنْهَضْنَ (istanhaḍna) /is.tan.hadˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَنْهَضَ (istanhaḍa)
# اِسْتَنْهِضْنَ (istanhiḍna) /is.tan.hidˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَنْهَضَ (istanhaḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
